sloka: ततः प्रासादशिखरं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् ।ददर्श राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।। ६.४१.८७ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ prāsādaśikharaṁ śailaśṛṅgamivonnatam ।dadarśa rākṣasendrasya vāliputraḥ pratāpavān ।। 6.41.87 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Angada holding the Rakshasas by his arms came down like birds on the roof of the palace which stood like a mountain.
